story: So grateful to have found the best vet clinic in the city when I first moved to philly. I've come in for emergency visits and well-checks always impressed. The receptionists are amazing, patient with clients & loving with the furry fam. When my senior cat (Macy 💚) was diagnosed with kidney disease Dr Ball was thorough & kind in helping me understand how to care for her. Prices are reasonable for the exceptional service. Mitch P.
